definition.model_description: Searches the immutable Tool Registry Snapshot available to the current agent by canonical name, display name, summary, and model description. Returns exact ToolId and ToolVersion references and an opaque cursor. It does not install, trust, pin, load, unload, or execute a tool. Use tools.describe to inspect an exact result and tools.load to expose selected tools to a later model step.
definition.model_summary: Search discoverable tools in the caller's exact registry snapshot.

definition.model_description: Read the authorized logical file, including editor buffer state. Use returned hash/range for a later precise patch. Core performs file access; no command process is started.

definition.display_name: Search text in the current session's logical workspace view
definition.model_description: Searches literal text or a supported single-line regular expression in the current session's logical workspace view. Results include unsaved editor buffer content when that content is authoritative for the session. The tool is implemented by Aura's Core Broker and does not run PowerShell, CMD, ripgrep, or another external process. Generated and ignored files are excluded by default unless explicitly requested and allowed. Results are deterministic, bounded, and may report a partial search with an explicit reason.
definition.model_summary: Search text in the current session's logical workspace view

limit.description: Maximum matches returned; use 1..=100. This searches text, not filenames.

scanned_file_count.description:
Files whose content was opened and examined. A file that is silently
excluded (binary content) is counted here *and* in
[`Self::skipped_file_count`], so the two counters are independent
observations and their sum may exceed the candidate count.

skipped_file_count.description:
Files not contributing matches: silently excluded content plus files
reported as skipped with a reason.

definition.model_description: Write UTF-8 text with an exact expected prior hash or absence. Core checks the current mode, file identity and editor ownership, then commits the existing atomic mutation and rollback journal.
Apply a unified diff to the exact expected file hash through the Core transaction. A changed identity/hash or forbidden path fails without silently changing the target.

Run a script with Aura managed PowerShell 7.6.5, fixed startup arguments/environment and no user Profile. Working directory is an authorized workspace path. Set requires_network when the command needs general network; low modes reject that requirement before execution. False never grants network. Low modes block general direct network; recorded system DNS mediation remains an accepted known limitation. FullAccess permits normal network and upload. Do not infer optional external program versions: inspect runtime context or query the program. Return actual direct execution output and exit code, including nonzero exits. Descendants may continue in Aura-owned background Jobs after the direct script returns; use shell.query or shell.stop. Unassessed side effects are not execution loss. No automatic retry.

definition.model_description: Search the public web without a required commercial Search API Key. WorkspaceReadWrite and FullAccess may search; ReadOnly is denied. Readable code, diagnostics and workspace text may be query input. No arbitrary headers/body/files, uploads or interactive browser authority are accepted. Unavailable retrieval surfaces return a clear error.

published_at.description: Search pages without a reliable publication date keep this absent.

definition.model_description: Fetch a public page through the controlled Web channel, returning a bounded document artifact. Private destinations and redirects outside the checked origin are rejected. Rendering requests fail explicitly until a separate retrieval renderer is available; the interactive user Browser profile is never used.
Read the next bounded section of a document already fetched in this session. ReadOnly cannot use Web tools. This does not fetch a new URL, run scripts, upload data or grant Browser access.
Read authorized persisted conversation events by exact selectors. Sources and original text remain distinct from summaries. Session/run identity is supplied by Core, never by tool arguments.

document.description: Core injects session/run; a model may select only already readable events.

definition.model_description: Read a persisted Tool result from the current task's accessible history. Foreign Artifact/Tool IDs cannot be used to cross session boundaries. Unknown execution remains Unknown.
Read this task's current TODO items and revision. TODO is bookkeeping, never a substitute for original user intent.
Replace task-local TODO items at the expected revision. TODO is working context; unfinished items do not veto the model completion decision.
Update an existing TODO at the exact expected revision. This changes task state only and does not modify workspace files.

Parent Plan mode only. Return structured uniquely identified steps and an acyclic dependency graph. Core inserts the original user goal verbatim. This call must be alone in the response's control batch with the exact current turn revision. Core does not grade the plan or require verification checklists.

original_user_goal.description: Loaded verbatim from User Events by Core, never accepted in Tool input.

definition.model_description: Read the owner's explicit Goal budget and consumed resources. A missing budget is not zero; budget exhaustion is not successful completion.
Record current evidence and remaining work without completing the Goal. This review is voluntary and is never a prerequisite for goal.complete.

Parent Goal mode only. Submit your decision to finish and final report at the exact current revision. Core validates identity and persistence, not completion quality. Budget exhaustion or stopping is not achievement. This call must be alone in its batch.

Ask only for missing input needed by the current task. Support text, single/multiple choices, confirmation and file/directory references. Do not request credentials or raw secrets. One pending query per task; authenticated user answers become original User Events and update task lineage revision.

Parent only. Inspect interrupted, topic-switched, or current lineages as readable background. They do not block ordinary tools. Do not infer that background records are the current task or that they can become Active again.

oneOf.description:
Model-marked background. Not user cancellation, not completion, and not
eligible for reactivation.

definition.model_description: Parent only. Express whether the current user message continues, changes, cancels, expires, or only references a prior record. Core binds session identity, the current user event, and live lineage revision; do not copy those fields. Interrupted and topic-switched lineages cannot become Active. expire_prior forbids relations and completion_policy_update. reference_prior forbids completion_policy_update. cancel_existing requires a cancels_task later excerpt. Ordinary tools and completion are available without first closing background records.

Prior errors, nonzero exits, Unknown results, unfinished TODO and managed background processes do not prevent completion.

definition.display_name: Decide an interrupted or paused mode
definition.model_description: Parent only, and only while Core reports mode_disposition.required. continue keeps the interrupted or paused Plan or Goal and, for Goal, ends the pause without resetting usage. skip marks that episode skipped and leaves this turn Normal. This call must be alone. Do not infer the decision from keywords. Query the user when the intent is unclear.
